objects.name: Yara rule: MidnightFrost_Loader
objects.pattern:
rule MidnightFrost_Loader {
    meta:
        description = "MidnightFrost loader strings"
    strings:
        $a = "FrostSvc" ascii
        $b = "MidnightFrostMtx" wide
    condition:
        any of them
}

objects.name: Sigma rule: MidnightFrost Run Key Persistence
objects.pattern:
title: MidnightFrost Run Key Persistence
id: 5f1c1d52-3c2b-4a58-9d1f-0b8f9a3c7e11
status: experimental
description: Detects the FrostSvc Run key written by MidnightFrost
logsource:
    category: registry_set
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        TargetObject|endswith: '\CurrentVersion\Run\FrostSvc'
    condition: selection
level: high

objects.name: Sigma rule: MidnightFrost Broken Rule
objects.pattern:
title: MidnightFrost Broken Rule
id: 0c9d2a11-7a4e-4f3b-8d52-6e1b3f7c9a20
status: experimental
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
level: medium

objects.name: Suricata rule: MidnightFrost beacon
objects.pattern: alert http $HOME_NET any -> $EXTERNAL_NET any (msg:"MidnightFrost beacon"; content:"/stage/payload.bin"; http.uri; sid:1000001; rev:1;)
